text:
Jordan Lee: quick check 1: do we want to adopt a minimal machine-readable retry hint for 429/503s? customers keep asking for something consistent across SDKs.
Priya Patel: +1 on minimal. prefer headers for low-cost clients. but we need a clear mapping to metrics so dashboards can use it without exploding cardinality.
Ibrahim Khan: runtime note: we currently emit `X-RW-Error` with freeform text. i'd rather we switch to `X-RW-Err-Reason` enum + optional `X-RW-Retry` seconds. keep it tiny.
Mei Wong: SDKs: if headers present, use those; fallback to body `retry_hint`. body schema proposal: `{\"retry_hint\":{\"retry_after\":12,\"reason\":\"quota\"|\"burst\",\"route\":\"r-44\"}}`
Jordan Lee: i like that. about `route` — we should gate full route exposure behind sampling. full route ids are sensitive for customers.
Priya Patel: telemetry: sample route-id at 0.25% by default for high-volume tenants, 1% default otherwise. we should tag events with `err_reason:quota|burst|overload` to keep dashboards aggregated.
Rachel O'Neill: console: we can show a compact badge using `reason` only. if `route` available show a drill-in link. add runbook links for each reason: /runbooks/err_quota, /runbooks/err_burst.
Ibrahim Khan: implementation plan: emit two headers always: `X-RW-Reason: quota|burst|overload` and `X-RW-Retry: 12` (seconds) then optionally include body `retry_hint` with `route` only when `sampling=on`. feature flag `err_hints_v1`.
Jordan Lee: versioning: clients will start parsing these, so we need a deprecation plan for legacy opaque bodies. propose: ship v1 as opt-in FF, enable for 10% of traffic for 1 week, 50% next week, then full.
Mei Wong: SDK changelog item and sample responses please. also create translation keys for console banners: `console.error.quota.short`, `console.error.quota.long`.
Priya Patel: metrics change: add `status_bucket` (ok, client_error, server_error, throttled) and an `err_reason` dimension. For storage cost, pre-aggregate by 1m windows for top 100 tenants.
metrics-bot: alert-config-updated: added rule `err_reason:quota` > 2% over 10m for any tenant -> page on-call.
Rachel O'Neill: UX ask: show a hint CTA in the console when a tenant hits quota errors with a CTA "View quota limits" linking to billing page.
Ibrahim Khan: i'll draft PR for runtime headers + body emit, FF toggle, and sampling control. will include unit tests for header precedence and sampling switch.
Jordan Lee: please ensure no PII leaks in `route` fields. security review required before broad rollout.
Priya Patel: i'll add sampling knobs to infra and a runbook entry for alert tuning.
Jordan Lee: thanks all. sync tomorrow 9:30am to go over rollout cadence. TL;DR: tiny enum headers + optional body `route` when sampled, FF rollout, metrics tagging and console badge + runbook.
